dict.string: SafetyCam AI needs camera access to capture photos of individuals. These photos are used for facial recognition analysis to search our criminal database and identify potential security threats. The facial data is processed on our secure servers and is not stored on your device. This feature helps you stay aware of potential safety risks in your surroundings.
SafetyCam AI needs permission to save photos to your library for your records.
SafetyCam AI needs access to your photo library to select existing photos for facial recognition analysis against our criminal database.

SafetyCam AI uses facial recognition technology to analyze uploaded photos and match them against our criminal suspect database. Face data is transmitted securely to our servers for processing and is not permanently stored on your device. This helps identify potential safety risks.
